faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: What people usually ask before getting started.

0.q: Do I need to change my document?
0.a: No. You just type the fields between double curly braces, like {{client_name}}, in the Word file you already use.

1.q: Will the PDF look like my Word file?
1.a: Yes. Your own document is the base, so header, footer, tables and formatting are preserved. If a font in the file isn't available, we warn you on upload.

2.q: Does my client need to install an app?
2.a: No. They open the link on their phone or computer, fill it in and submit.

3.q: Does it work for my kind of business?
3.a: If the document is in Word and someone fills it by hand or copies data from a message today, it works: schools, clinics, gyms, real estate, service providers and more.

4.a: You start free, no credit card needed, and can generate your first documents right away.

5.q: What if I just need a form?
5.a: That works too. Submitin is still a complete form builder, with templates, real-time responses and CSV export.
